biotools.summary:
Tool to generate a count matrix for expression data in Galaxy. 

generate_count_matrix reads in one or more input text files with expression counts and produces a single combined file. Each input will have a column in the matrix containing expression values.

The column containing gene (or feature) names should be identical for all input count files.
